blocks.text: Marawi/Bukidnon—“A society that mocks virtue prepares its own collapse.” That’s how Socrates’ politically immortal wisdom is usually summarized. Unquestionably, ours is a divided nation, and ”virtue”—as understood by ancient Greeks—is sorely missing among our leaders.
